task_description: Integrate 62 standalone solutions (apps) into the 3W Online site stack (Vue 3 + TS + Tailwind + Iconify + Pinia + SweetAlert2). Covers: Soluções dropdown in navbar (T1), SolucaoLayout/SolucaoView/index.ts architecture (T2), 62 ported Vue components (T3), router with 62 individual routes (T4), and Solucoes.vue catalog page with ?cat= filter (T5).
